fishes text index | photo index fishes Fishes with flat headsHow to tell them apart?updated Apr 2020

Several different kinds of fishes have flat heads. Here’s more on how to tell them apart.


FlatheadFamily Platycephalidae

Crocodile flathead gobyFamily Gobiidae

DragonetFamily Callionymidae Mouth huge from ‘ear to ear’.
Long rounded snout.

Eyes covered with ‘fringe’ or ‘eyelids’ Mouth huge from ‘ear to ear’.
Medium rounded snout.

Eyes with a small ‘eyelid’. Mouth small.
Short pointed snout.

More comparisons

Tongue-soles
Family Cynoglossidae

Soles
Family Soleidae

Large-tooth flounders
Family Paralichthyidae
